arStrings.szText:
Harness Horadric artifacts to craft your own spell. 
Link it to your skills to unleash its power.
Harness the Power of the Horadrim to craft a spell. Link {icon:HoradricPower_FlatIcon_Catalyst, 2.}{c:FF9A5780}Catalyst{/c} to one of your skills on the {c:FF9A5780}Action Bar{/c}.
Equip an {icon:HoradricPower_FlatIcon_Infusion, 2.} {c:FFeeb91a}Infusion{/c} to imbue your spell with an elemental damage type and special bonuses.
Equip up to 3 {icon:HoradricPower_FlatIcon_Arcana, 2.} {c:FF4ca7d6}Arcana{/c} to further enhance and customize your spell.
